schema_note: 多因子流程配置示例；执行前由本次指定引擎显式适配和检验，不宣称旧内置入口已支持这些字段。
training_sample_rule: signal, entry and target maturity must all lie in the training interval
daily_budget: previous_close_nav / (hold_days + 1), constrained by settled cash and opening gross headroom
cash_reuse: shared settled cash; overdue securities tracked separately
